_calibration_note: claude-opus-5 cache_write corrected 6.25 -> 10.0 after calibration against a real claude -p result (see task-8-report.md). The observed costUSD exactly matches the 1-hour cache TTL write rate (2x input) rather than the 5-minute TTL rate (1.25x input) originally assumed. This harness has no field distinguishing 5m vs 1h cache_creation_input_tokens, so this rate is a best single-value approximation, not a universal truth -- a 5-minute-TTL run would be overpriced by this table. sonnet-5 and haiku cache_write rates are unverified (no calibration data).
